goal: Protect nodes from memory exhaustion caused by peers sending blocks packed with empty transactions
Reject transactions that could never be valid early to bound allocation sizes for inputs and outputs
agreement: Strong support with all open concerns addressed (maflcko, Yudis-bit)
Simplified after concern that performance gains did not justify stream complexity (maflcko)
Verified with code review and tests after agreeing to defer disconnect handling (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it mitigates peer-triggered memory exhaustion DoS attacks during message deserialization
Prevents peers from forcing nodes to allocate memory for hundreds of thousands of empty transactions
Avoids unbounded vector reallocations when handling oversized input or output counts

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it limits worst-case memory allocations during transaction deserialization
Changes consensus primitive parsing requiring careful review to ensure no valid data is rejected
